correctness.rationale: The 87 frozen facets give f=(15,102,174,87). An independently implemented JS reconstruction computed all 417 triangular cliques, subtracting 174 faces to give 243 candidates. Exact permutation products of the fetched EDGE_WORDS verify each of 174 face relators, and the generated image has order 24. The primary Lutz topology identifies pi1 with the order-24 binary tetrahedral group, so the surjective representation is an isomorphism. Each missing triangle maps nontrivially: 215 order six in two inverse conjugacy classes with hits 110 and 105, 28 order four in one inverse-stable class. The commutator subgroup has order eight and contains exactly the 28 order-four instances, giving the H1 split. Simple cycles cannot have fewer than three edges.
